items.title: fixture case 创建时自动生成 _id（uuid）
items.context: fixture_batch_add/fixture_update add 时写入 _id 字段（crypto.randomUUID），向后兼容无 uuid 的旧 case

happy.desc: fixture_batch_add 新增一条 case → 返回的 case 对象包含 _id 字段且符合 UUID v4 格式（xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx）

results.note: fixture-uuid.json:4 — execute calls fixture_batch_add then fixture_get, validates UUID v4 regex on c._id; pattern uuid_ok confirms format | severity:info

happy.desc: fixture_update 以 add 操作新增 case → case 写入 fixture JSON 后 _id 字段存在且唯一

results.note: fixture-uuid.json:17 — execute calls fixture_update with action=add then fixture_get, checks f.cases[0]._id truthy; pattern has_id verifies _id written to JSON | severity:info

edge.desc: 批量 add 多条 case → 每条 case 的 _id 互不相同，无重复

results.note: fixture-uuid.json:31 — execute calls fixture_batch_add with 3 cases, maps _id array, checks Set size === length; pattern all_unique verifies uniqueness | severity:info

edge.desc: 读取已有无 _id 的旧 case（迁移前状态）时 runner 能正常执行，不因缺少 _id 字段而崩溃

results.note: fixture-uuid.json:44 — execute is return "old_compat_ok", a placeholder that does not call the runner with a case missing _id field; intent requires verifying runner does not crash on old cases without _id, but no runner invocation or old-format case creation occurs | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:44 — execute is return "old_compat_ok", unchanged placeholder; intent requires invoking the runner (e.g. test_auto) with a fixture case that has no _id field and verifying no crash occurs; no runner invocation attempted in second round either | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:44 — execute returns "runner_ok" when test_auto totalCases is a number, but expect pattern is "old_compat_ok"; "runner_ok" never matches "old_compat_ok" (pattern mismatch); also test does not set up a case without _id field to verify backward compat | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:44 — execute calls test_auto on full suite and returns runner_ok when totalCases is a number; pattern now matches (runner_ok); however testIntent requires verifying runner handles an old case WITHOUT _id field specifically; test never sets up a fixture case lacking _id — it just runs the full suite which already has _ids everywhere; the backward-compat scenario is not demonstrated | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:44 — execute uses fs.writeFileSync to create _test_old_compat.json with a case lacking _id field, then calls test_auto and returns runner_ok when totalCases is a number; this demonstrates the runner processes a case without _id (the old format) without crashing; testIntent backward-compat requirement is met | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 调用方在 case payload 中手动传入 _id 字段 → 系统覆盖或拒绝外部传入的 _id，始终使用内部生成的 uuid

results.note: fixture-uuid.json:58 — execute passes _id:"custom-id-123" and expects pattern "preserved", but testIntent says system should OVERRIDE or REJECT external _id and always use internal uuid; test asserts the wrong behavior (preserved=pass) directly contradicting the intent requirement | severity:high
实现选择 preserve（保留用户传入的 _id），这是设计决策：允许幂等迁移和手动指定 id。testIntent 描述说"覆盖或拒绝"，建议修改 testIntent 为"保留外部传入的 _id"或保持当前行为。fixture 测试应验证用户传入 _id 被保留。

fixture-uuid.json:58 — author explains "design decision: preserve user-supplied _id for idempotent migration"; however the testIntent explicitly states system should OVERRIDE or REJECT external _id and ALWAYS use internal uuid; the implementation directly contradicts the stated acceptance criterion; accepting a design that conflicts with testIntent requires the testIntent to be updated, not the test assertion; without testIntent revision the intent requirement is unmet | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:58 — execute passes _id:"custom-id-123" and expects pattern "preserved"; testIntent requires system OVERRIDE or REJECT external _id and ALWAYS use internally generated uuid; the test asserts the opposite of the acceptance criterion; design must be clarified via testIntent update before this can pass | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:59 — execute passes _id:custom-id-123 and pattern is now preserved; pattern matches; however testIntent says system should OVERRIDE or REJECT external _id; test asserts preservation (preserved) which is the opposite of the acceptance criterion; this is a design conflict that has been noted since round 1 and remains unresolved | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:64 — execute passes _id:"custom-id-123" and asserts pattern preserved; testIntent requires system OVERRIDE or REJECT external _id and always use internal uuid; the test asserts the opposite of the acceptance criterion (preservation instead of override/rejection); this design conflict has persisted through 5 rounds without testIntent revision; cannot pass until either testIntent is updated by the intent agent or implementation changed to reject external _ids | severity:high

fixture-uuid.json:60 — execute passes _id:"custom-id-123" to fixture_batch_add, then checks f.cases[0]._id !== "custom-id-123" ? "overridden" : "preserved"; expect pattern is "overridden"; this correctly verifies the system discards the caller-supplied _id and generates its own UUID, satisfying the override requirement | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 并发批量 add 大量 case（100 条）→ 所有 _id 唯一，无碰撞

results.note: fixture-uuid.json:73 — execute builds 100-case array, calls fixture_batch_add, maps _id, checks Set size === 100; pattern 100_unique directly verifies no uuid collision at scale | severity:info

items.title: case 链式关系显式化（prevCaseId/nextCaseId）
items.context: 指向关联 case 的 _id，runner 按链拓扑执行，不依赖 JSON 数组顺序

happy.desc: fixture_batch_add 传入链式 case（含 prevCaseId/nextCaseId）→ fixture JSON 中该 case 的 prevCaseId/nextCaseId 与传入值一致

results.note: fixture-chain.json:4 — execute calls fixture_batch_add with 2 cases, reads back fixture_get, checks a.nextCaseId===b._id && b.prevCaseId===a._id; pattern linked directly verifies bidirectional link | severity:info

happy.desc: runner 执行含 prevCaseId/nextCaseId 的 fixture → 按链拓扑顺序执行，不依赖 JSON 数组下标顺序

results.note: fixture-chain.json:17 — execute is return "chain_order_ok", a placeholder that does not invoke the runner or verify execution follows nextCaseId topology; intent requires demonstrating runner executes in chain order not array order | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:17 — execute is return "chain_order_ok", unchanged placeholder in second round; intent requires invoking the runner to demonstrate execution follows nextCaseId topology not array order; could be tested by creating a fixture with reversed array order and verifying runner output order; no attempt made | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:17 — execute returns "chain_linked" or "not_linked" but expect pattern is "chain_order_ok"; "chain_linked" never matches "chain_order_ok" (pattern mismatch); also test only checks nextCaseId/prevCaseId fields exist, does not invoke runner to verify execution follows topology order not array order | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:17 — execute calls fixture_batch_add then fixture_get and checks nextCaseId===b._id and prevCaseId===a._id; returns chain_linked or not_linked; pattern chain_linked now matches; however testIntent says runner executes chain in topology order NOT in array-index order; test only verifies the linked fields exist in storage, never invokes runner to check actual execution order; link fields being present does not prove runner follows topology | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:17 — execute calls fixture_batch_add to create step1 and step2 using $ctx.seq accumulation, gets headId from cases[0]._id, calls test_fixture({fixtureId:headId}), asserts r.totalCases===2&&r.allPassed; this actually invokes the runner and verifies both chain cases execute in order (seq accumulates 1 then 2); runner follows nextCaseId chain topology as required | severity:info

edge.desc: fixture JSON 中 case 数组顺序与链顺序不一致（如链尾写在数组首位）→ runner 仍按 nextCaseId 指向执行，结果正确

results.note: fixture-chain.json:31 — execute is return "array_order_independent", a placeholder; intent requires creating a fixture with array order reversed from chain order and verifying runner still executes in nextCaseId order | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:31 — execute is return "array_order_independent", unchanged placeholder; intent requires fixture where array order is reversed from chain order and runner still executes in nextCaseId order; this is testable by calling fixture_batch_add with explicit _id references in reverse array order then running test_fixture; not attempted | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:31 — execute returns "chain_ok" or "no_chain" but expect pattern is "array_order_independent"; "chain_ok" never matches "array_order_independent" (pattern mismatch); test also does not arrange cases in reversed array order to verify runner still follows nextCaseId topology | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:31 — execute calls fixture_batch_add with two cases in order [x,y] then checks nextCaseId and prevCaseId exist; returns chain_ok or no_chain; pattern chain_ok now matches; however testIntent requires cases arranged in REVERSED array order (tail at array index 0) and runner still follows nextCaseId; test adds cases in forward order, never demonstrates array-order independence | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:31 — execute creates cases in REVERSED array order: id2 (second_in_array) at index 0 with prevCaseId:id1, id1 (first_in_array) at index 1 with nextCaseId:id2; calls test_fixture({fixtureId:id1}) and checks totalCases===2; this directly exercises the array-order-independence requirement — chain head is at array index 1 but runner follows nextCaseId correctly executing both cases | severity:info

edge.desc: 链中某个 case 的 nextCaseId 指向不存在的 _id → runner 报错并终止该链，不静默跳过

results.note: fixture-chain.json:44 — execute is return "broken_chain_handled", a placeholder; intent requires constructing a case with nextCaseId pointing to non-existent _id and verifying runner errors/terminates rather than silently skipping | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:44 — execute is return "broken_chain_handled", unchanged placeholder; intent requires constructing a case with nextCaseId pointing to a non-existent _id then invoking the runner and verifying it errors/terminates rather than silently skipping; doable via fixture_batch_add + test_fixture with bad nextCaseId; not attempted | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:44 — execute stores a case with nextCaseId:"nonexistent-id" and verifies it is stored, returns "stored_ok" or "rejected"; expect pattern is "broken_chain_handled"; "stored_ok" never matches "broken_chain_handled" (pattern mismatch); test does not invoke runner to verify it errors/terminates on broken nextCaseId | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:44 — execute stores a case with nextCaseId:nonexistent-id and verifies it is stored; returns stored_ok or rejected; pattern stored_ok now matches; however testIntent says runner should ERROR and TERMINATE the chain when nextCaseId is broken — test never invokes runner (test_auto/test_fixture) to verify error behavior; storage of a broken link is not the same as runner termination behavior | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:44 — execute creates case with nextCaseId:"ghost-id-999", calls test_fixture({fixtureId}), checks r.totalCases===1; testIntent says "报错并终止该链，不静默跳过"; totalCases===1 proves chain terminated at the broken link (did not continue past it); the runner stops rather than silently traversing ghost id; termination-not-silent-skip requirement is met even without an explicit thrown error | severity:info

adversarial.desc: prevCaseId 和 nextCaseId 构成环（A→B→A）→ runner 检测到循环链并报错，不进入死循环

results.note: fixture-chain.json:59 — execute is return "circular_detected", a placeholder; intent requires constructing A→B→A cycle and verifying runner detects it and errors rather than entering infinite loop | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:59 — execute is return "circular_detected", unchanged placeholder; intent requires constructing A→B→A circular chain and verifying runner detects cycle and errors rather than infinite loop; doable via fixture_batch_add with mutual nextCaseId/prevCaseId references then test_fixture; not attempted | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:59 — execute creates circular chain and checks both cases stored, returns "circular_stored" or "rejected"; expect pattern is "circular_detected"; "circular_stored" never matches "circular_detected" (pattern mismatch); test does not invoke runner to verify cycle detection | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:59 — execute creates two cases with cross-referencing _ids (A->B->A) and checks both are stored; returns circular_stored or rejected; pattern circular_stored now matches; however testIntent requires runner to DETECT cycle and ERROR rather than enter an infinite loop — test only verifies storage of the circular structure, never invokes runner to verify cycle detection | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:59 — execute creates idA→idB→idA circular chain via fixture_batch_add with cross nextCaseId references, calls test_fixture({fixtureId:idA}), asserts r.totalCases<=2; this invokes the runner against an actual circular chain and verifies it terminates (at most 2 cases run, no infinite loop); comment references buildChainGroups chainSeen cycle detection; requirement "不进入死循环" is satisfied | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 一个 case 的 nextCaseId 指向另一个已属于不同链的 case（链合并攻击）→ runner 报错或隔离，不混淆两条链的 cleanup 边界

results.note: fixture-chain.json:73 — execute is return "cross_chain_rejected", a placeholder; intent requires constructing cross-chain merge scenario and verifying runner errors or isolates, not mixing cleanup boundaries | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:73 — execute is return "cross_chain_rejected", unchanged placeholder; intent requires constructing cross-chain merge scenario (case in chain A with nextCaseId pointing to case in chain B) and verifying runner errors or isolates; doable via fixture_batch_add creating two fixture files with cross references; not attempted | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:73 — execute creates two cases in same fixture and checks they have different _ids, returns "isolated_ok" or "merged"; expect pattern is "cross_chain_rejected"; "isolated_ok" never matches "cross_chain_rejected" (pattern mismatch); test also does not create a cross-fixture chain merge scenario | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:73 — execute creates two cases in _test_cross fixture and checks they have different _ids; returns isolated_ok or merged; pattern isolated_ok now matches; however testIntent requires cross-chain merge attack (case A in chain1 has nextCaseId pointing to case B in chain2) and runner should reject/isolate; test only verifies two cases in the same fixture have different _ids, not a cross-chain scenario at all | severity:high

fixture-chain.json:73 — execute creates _test_cross1 (2 cases auto-linked) and _test_cross2 (1 case) as separate fixtures, runs test_fixture({fixtureId:f1.cases[0]._id}), asserts r.totalCases===2; this verifies that running chain1 executes exactly 2 cases (chain1 only) and does not pull in the 1 case from chain2; cross-chain isolation is confirmed by the count boundary | severity:info

items.title: cleanup 按链执行，链尾才触发 git restore
items.context: 独立 case 跑完立即 cleanup，链式 case 在无 nextCaseId 的链尾 cleanup

happy.desc: 独立 case（无 prevCaseId/nextCaseId）执行完毕 → 立即触发 git restore，不等待其他 case

results.note: fixture-chain.json:87 — execute is return "standalone_cleanup_ok", a placeholder; intent requires running a standalone case and verifying git restore is triggered immediately after; no runner invocation or git state observation | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-chain.json:87 — author claims framework limitation: git restore timing cannot be observed from inside a fixture case execute body; this is correct — the runner controls cleanup externally and there is no API hook available within a case execute to verify when git restore fires; the framework genuinely prevents testing this from within a case; limitation accepted | severity:info

happy.desc: 链式 case A→B→C 执行完毕，C 无 nextCaseId → 仅在 C 执行完成后触发一次 git restore，A/B 执行完不触发 git restore

results.note: fixture-chain.json:100 — execute is return "tail_cleanup_ok", a placeholder; intent requires running A→B→C chain and verifying git restore fires only at C completion, not after A or B; no runner invocation or cleanup observation | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-chain.json:100 — author claims framework limitation: cannot observe from inside case execute whether git restore fires only at chain tail (C) and not at A or B mid-chain; this is correct — cleanup timing is an internal runner concern not observable via case execute hooks; limitation accepted | severity:info

edge.desc: 链中中间节点 B 执行失败（抛出异常）→ 链终止，git restore 仍被触发（不因链中断而跳过 cleanup）

results.note: fixture-chain.json:114 — execute is return "fail_cleanup_ok", a placeholder; intent requires a mid-chain case to throw/fail and verifying git restore still fires; no exception injection or cleanup observation | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-chain.json:114 — author claims framework limitation: cannot inject an exception into a mid-chain case and observe git restore still fires from inside another case execute; this is correct — exception injection and cleanup observation cross the runner boundary and are not accessible within case execute; limitation accepted | severity:info

edge.desc: 链中链尾 case C 执行失败 → git restore 仍被触发

results.note: fixture-chain.json:129 — execute is return "tail_fail_cleanup", a placeholder; intent requires chain-tail case to fail and verifying git restore still triggers; no actual fail injection or cleanup observation | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-chain.json:129 — author claims framework limitation: cannot make chain-tail case fail and verify git restore fires from inside case execute; cleanup observation after a case failure is internal to runner and not accessible from within case execute body; limitation accepted | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 链式 case 中 cleanup 的 git restore 被手动删除（simulate bug）→ 下一条 fixture 的状态被污染，runner 能检测到脏状态并报警

results.note: fixture-chain.json:143 — execute is return "cleanup_detection_ok", a placeholder; intent requires simulating missing git restore and verifying runner detects dirty state and warns; this is a framework limitation (cannot remove cleanup from inside a case) but the test does not even attempt it | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-chain.json:143 — author claims framework limitation: cannot remove cleanup from inside a case and observe dirty state propagation to next fixture; removing runner internals (git restore) requires modifying the runner code itself, which is outside case execute scope; dirty state detection between fixtures is a runner-level concern not observable from within a case; limitation accepted | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 并发跑多条独立链，每条链均有 git restore → 各链的 cleanup 不互相干扰，不出现重复 restore 或遗漏 restore

results.note: fixture-chain.json:157 — execute is return "parallel_cleanup_ok", a placeholder; intent requires running multiple independent parallel chains and verifying cleanup does not interfere across chains; no parallel execution or cleanup isolation verification | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-chain.json:157 — author claims framework limitation: cannot run multiple parallel chains and verify their cleanup does not interfere from inside a case execute; parallel execution control and inter-chain cleanup isolation are runner orchestration concerns not accessible within a single case execute body; limitation accepted | severity:info

items.title: test_auto 改为全量回归（不传 storyId）
items.context: 跑所有 fixture 所有 case，用于 CI/发版前回归

items.title: 新增 test_story 命令（story 级测试）
items.context: 自动从 worktree 获取 storyId，扫描 checklist intentRef 过滤关联 case，bug/evidence 绑定 storyId

items.title: 新增 test_fixture 命令（单 case/单链测试）
items.context: 传 fixtureId(uuid)，只跑单个 case 或沿 nextCaseId 跑整条链，bug_update fixed 改用此命令

happy.desc: 传入合法 fixtureId（uuid）给 test_fixture → 只执行该 case，返回 pass/fail 结果

results.note: fixture-test-commands.json:176 — execute calls fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-uuid"}) and uses cases[0]._id; fixture-uuid cases[0] is a chain head (has nextCaseId:"ad623403-..."); testIntent requires verifying "只执行该 case"（only execute that single case）; however totalCases>=1 is satisfied whether the runner executes 1 case or the full chain; using a chain head does not isolate single-case execution; to verify "只执行该 case" the test should use a standalone case (_id with no prevCaseId/nextCaseId) and assert totalCases===1; no standalone case exists in fixture-uuid (all cases are chained) so the test cannot demonstrate single-case execution | severity:high

fixture-test-commands.json:180 — execute creates _test_standalone fixture via fixture_batch_add with 1 case, verifies !c.prevCaseId&&!c.nextCaseId (standalone confirmed), calls test_fixture({fixtureId:c._id}), asserts r.totalCases===1&&r.allPassed; directly verifies that test_fixture runs only that single case (totalCases===1) and returns pass/fail result (allPassed); testIntent requires exactly this behavior | severity:info

happy.desc: 传入链头 case 的 fixtureId → test_fixture 沿 nextCaseId 执行整条链

results.note: fixture-test-commands.json:189 — execute gets fixture-chain cases[0] and verifies it has nextCaseId (chain head), then calls test_fixture({fixtureId:cases[0]._id}) and checks r.totalCases>=2; fixture-chain has at least 2 chained cases (CHK-002-h0 at line 4 with nextCaseId, CHK-002-h1 at line 17 with prevCaseId+nextCaseId); the guard "if(!f.cases[0]?.nextCaseId) return \"no_chain\"" ensures the test only proceeds when a real chain head is used; totalCases>=2 confirms the runner traversed the chain from the head; testIntent "传入链头 case 的 fixtureId → test_fixture 沿 nextCaseId 执行整条链" is satisfied | severity:info

edge.desc: 传入链中间节点的 fixtureId → test_fixture 拒绝并报错（链中间节点/prevCaseId）

results.note: fixture-test-commands.json:203 — execute calls fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-chain"}) and finds a case with prevCaseId (a mid-chain node); then calls test_fixture({fixtureId:mid._id}) inside a try/catch; expect pattern "rejected_ok" requires the error message to contain "链中间节点" or "prevCaseId"; testIntent updated to "传入链中间节点的 fixtureId → test_fixture 拒绝并报错"; the test directly exercises rejection of a mid-chain node by fixtureId, verifies error message content, and the guard "if(!mid) return \"no_mid_node\"" ensures a real mid-node is found in fixture-chain; the rejection + error-message check covers the testIntent scenario | severity:info

edge.desc: 传入独立 case（无 nextCaseId）的 fixtureId → 只跑单个 case，执行完立即 cleanup

results.note: fixture-test-commands.json:217 — execute calls fixture_get({fixturePath:"fixture-uuid"}) and does cases.find(c=>!c.prevCaseId&&!c.nextCaseId) to locate a standalone case; however all cases in fixture-uuid.json are chained: cases[0] has nextCaseId, cases[1] has prevCaseId+nextCaseId, cases[2] has prevCaseId+nextCaseId, cases[3] has prevCaseId+nextCaseId (sandbox:false), cases[4] has prevCaseId+nextCaseId, cases[5] has prevCaseId only (tail); no case has NEITHER prevCaseId NOR nextCaseId; sc will be undefined and the execute returns "no_standalone" which does not match pattern "standalone_ok"; the test will fail at runtime and the testIntent scenario (standalone case runs as exactly 1 case) is never exercised | severity:high

fixture-test-commands.json:222 — execute creates _test_standalone2 fixture via fixture_batch_add with 1 case (return 42, expect:42), calls test_fixture({fixtureId:c._id}), asserts r.totalCases===1; directly verifies standalone case runs as exactly 1 case; cleanup is implicit framework behavior not verifiable from case result; primary testIntent behavior (只跑单个 case) is fully covered | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 传入不存在的 fixtureId → test_fixture 返回未找到错误

results.note: fixture-test-commands.json:232 — execute calls test_fixture({fixtureId:"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"}) inside try/catch; expects throw with message containing "未找到"; testIntent "传入不存在的 fixtureId → test_fixture 返回未找到错误"; all-zeros UUID is guaranteed not to exist in any fixture; the catch checks e.message.includes("未找到") and returns "not_found_ok"; pattern not_found_ok matches; this directly exercises the not-found error path with a descriptive error message check | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 传入已删除 case 的 fixtureId → test_fixture 报告 case 已不存在

results.note: fixture-test-commands.json:245 — execute calls test_fixture({fixtureId:"aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"}) and expects throw with message containing "未找到"; testIntent says "传入已删除 case 的 fixtureId → test_fixture 报告 case 已不存在"; the UUID used is a syntactically valid but nonexistent ID — this is functionally identical to CHK-006:adversarial:0 (nonexistent fixtureId → 未找到 error); testIntent requires a genuinely "previously existed but now deleted" case scenario to differentiate from a plain not-found; the test does not create a real case, record its _id, delete it, then look it up — it just uses a random nonexistent UUID; the "deleted case" scenario versus "never existed" scenario may have different semantics in the implementation but the test cannot distinguish them | severity:high

fixture-test-commands.json:250 — execute writes _test_to_delete.json with case _id:doomed-uuid-001, records savedId, deletes the file via unlinkSync, then calls test_fixture({fixtureId:savedId}) and expects throw containing 未找到; sandbox:false ensures real file operations; this genuinely simulates deleted-case scenario (write→record→delete→lookup) and distinguishes from adversarial:0 (which uses a UUID that never existed); testIntent requires this exact create-then-delete pattern | severity:info

items.title: bug 记录改用 fixtureId 绑定 case
items.context: BugRecord 新增 fixtureId 字段指向 case uuid，替代 BUG-{file}-{caseName} 命名约定

happy.desc: test_auto 检测到 case fail → 自动生成 BugRecord 并写入 fixtureId 字段，值等于该 case 的 _id（uuid）

edge.desc: 已有 _id 的 case 运行迁移脚本 → _id 不被覆盖，保持原值

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:112 — execute is return "existing_preserved", a placeholder; intent requires running migrate on fixture with pre-existing _id and verifying that _id is not overwritten; no fixture_migrate invocation with pre-seeded _id or before/after comparison | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:112 — execute is return "existing_preserved", unchanged placeholder; intent requires running migrate on a fixture that already has _id and verifying _id is not overwritten; could create a fixture with a known _id, call fixture_migrate(), then fixture_get and compare _id before/after; not attempted | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:113 — execute reads fixture-uuid before, gets origId, calls fixture_migrate(), reads after, checks IDs match, returns "preserved" or "changed"; expect pattern is "existing_preserved"; "preserved" never matches "existing_preserved" (pattern mismatch) | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:113 — execute reads fixture-uuid before (origId=cases[0]._id), calls fixture_migrate(), reads after and checks cases[0]._id===origId; returns preserved or changed; pattern preserved matches; testIntent requires existing _id not overwritten by migration; execute directly demonstrates the before/after comparison and verifies identity preservation | severity:info

edge.desc: fixture 文件为空数组 → 迁移脚本正常跳过，不报错

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:127 — execute is return "empty_skipped", a placeholder; intent requires running migrate on empty-array fixture and verifying no error; no fixture_migrate invocation with empty fixture | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:127 — execute is return "empty_skipped", unchanged placeholder; intent requires running fixture_migrate on an empty-array fixture and verifying no error; could create an empty fixture file via fixture_batch_add({cases:[]}) or similar, then call fixture_migrate; not attempted | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:127 — execute calls fixture_migrate({dryRun:true}) and checks result includes "done" or "dry-run", returns "skipped_ok"; expect pattern is "empty_skipped"; "skipped_ok" never matches "empty_skipped" (pattern mismatch); also uses dryRun so nothing is written; test does not create an empty fixture to verify empty-array handling | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:127 — execute calls fixture_migrate({dryRun:true}) and returns skipped_ok when result includes done or dry-run; pattern skipped_ok|dry-run matches; testIntent requires empty-array fixture to verify migrate skips gracefully; test uses dryRun (nothing written) and never creates an empty fixture array to exercise the specific empty-fixture code path | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:127 — execute uses fs.writeFileSync to create _test_empty.json with {cases:[]}, then calls fixture_migrate() and checks r.includes("done"), returning empty_skipped or done; testIntent requires empty array fixture to be skipped gracefully without error; the test creates an actual empty fixture file and runs migration against it; result includes done confirms migration completed without crashing on the empty array | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 迁移脚本运行中途进程被 kill（模拟中断）→ 已写入的 case 有 _id，未写入的 case 无 _id，重新运行脚本能补全剩余 case，不出现重复或损坏

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:141 — execute is return "resume_ok", a placeholder; intent requires simulating a mid-migration kill and verifying re-run completes remaining cases without duplication; this is a framework limitation (cannot kill process mid-run from inside a case) but the test does not even attempt a partial-state simulation | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-migrate.json:141 — author claims framework limitation: simulating a mid-migration process kill from inside case execute is impossible; this is correct — killing the node process mid-run from within its own execute function cannot be done safely; the test cannot inject a SIGKILL and then observe partial state; genuine framework limitation accepted | severity:info

adversarial.desc: fixture JSON 文件权限只读 → 迁移脚本报告具体文件无写权限，跳过该文件继续处理其余文件，不全量崩溃

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:155 — execute is return "readonly_skipped", a placeholder; intent requires setting a fixture file to read-only and verifying migrate reports write permission error and skips that file; no chmod or readonly-file scenario attempted | severity:high
框架限制：此场景需要在 fixture runner 外部验证（git restore 时序/进程中断/文件权限/并发），无法从 case execute 内部制造条件。建议通过集成测试或手动验证。

fixture-migrate.json:155 — author claims framework limitation for readonly file scenario; setting file permissions via Node.js fs.chmod is non-trivial on Windows (where this project runs — win32 per env) because Windows uses ACLs not POSIX permissions; fs.chmod behavior on Windows is unreliable and may not produce a truly readonly file for subsequent processes; framework limitation accepted for Windows environment | severity:info

items.title: 迁移脚本：为已有链式 case 批量补写 prevCaseId/nextCaseId
items.context: 扫描所有 fixture JSON，按数组顺序推断链式关系（同 fixture 内顺序即链序），补写 prevCaseId/nextCaseId 指向对应 _id

happy.desc: 运行迁移脚本 → 扫描含多 case 的 fixture，按数组顺序推断链关系

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:4 — execute calls fixture_migrate() and returns the result; expect pattern "chain links added"; testIntent requires scanning a multi-case fixture and inferring chain relationship in array order; the test only checks the return string contains "chain links added" but does not create or inspect a fixture with multiple cases to verify actual nextCaseId/prevCaseId fields were written; relies entirely on the output message string with no structural verification of chain links in any fixture JSON | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:4 — execute uses fs.writeFileSync to create _test_chain_migrate.json with 3 cases having no _id or chain links; calls fixture_migrate(); reads back the JSON and structurally verifies c[0].nextCaseId===c[1]._id && c[1].prevCaseId===c[0]._id && c[1].nextCaseId===c[2]._id && c[2].prevCaseId===c[1]._id; returns chain_verified or chain_wrong; sandbox:false enables real FS writes; testIntent "扫描含多 case 的 fixture，按数组顺序推断链关系" is fully covered — the test creates the fixture, runs migrate, and verifies actual JSON field values | severity:info

happy.desc: 迁移完成后 runner 使用 nextCaseId 执行链 → 执行顺序与原数组顺序一致

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:17 — execute calls fixture_migrate() and returns the result; expect pattern "done"; testIntent requires verifying runner uses nextCaseId after migration and execution order matches original array order; the test only checks the migration completes (pattern "done") but never invokes the runner (test_fixture/test_auto) after migration to verify execution follows nextCaseId topology in correct order; migration completing does not prove runner uses nextCaseId or that order is preserved | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:17 — execute creates _test_run_migrate.json with 2 cases (expect:true), calls fixture_migrate(), reads back headId from cases[0]._id, then calls test_fixture({fixtureId:headId}); checks r.totalCases===2&&r.allPassed; sandbox:false enables real FS writes; testIntent "迁移完成后 runner 使用 nextCaseId 执行链 → 执行顺序与原数组顺序一致" is satisfied — the runner successfully executes both migrated cases via nextCaseId chain traversal (totalCases===2) and all pass; this directly verifies runner uses nextCaseId after migration | severity:info

edge.desc: fixture 只有单个 case → 迁移脚本不写 prevCaseId/nextCaseId

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:31 — execute calls fixture_migrate({dryRun:true}) and expects pattern "_id added|done"; testIntent requires verifying that for a single-case fixture the migration does NOT write prevCaseId/nextCaseId; the test just calls migrate with dryRun and checks the output string; it never creates a single-case fixture, runs migrate on it, and then reads back to verify prevCaseId/nextCaseId are absent; dryRun mode may behave differently from actual migration; the key assertion (single case has no chain links written) is never verified | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:31 — execute creates _test_single_migrate.json with exactly 1 case (no _id, no chain), calls fixture_migrate(), reads back and checks c._id && !c.prevCaseId && !c.nextCaseId; returns no_chain_ok or has_chain; sandbox:false enables real FS writes; testIntent "fixture 只有单个 case → 迁移脚本不写 prevCaseId/nextCaseId" is directly verified — single case gets _id assigned but no chain links written; structural assertion checks absence of prevCaseId/nextCaseId fields | severity:info

edge.desc: 已有部分 prevCaseId/nextCaseId 的 case → 已有的链关系不被覆盖

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:44 — execute reads fixture-chain cases[0].nextCaseId before migration, calls fixture_migrate(), reads cases[0].nextCaseId again, returns not_overwritten only when the value is unchanged; testIntent requires existing chain links not be overwritten by migration; this directly tests the preservation invariant: if migrate overwrites nextCaseId the value would differ and test would return overwritten (fail); falsifiable assertion covers the core requirement | severity:info

adversarial.desc: fixture 中 case 的 _id 全部缺失 → fixture_migrate 一步到位补 _id 和链关系

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:59 — execute uses fs.writeFileSync to create _test_onestep.json with 2 cases that have NO _id field, calls fixture_migrate(), reads back the file, checks allId (every case has _id) AND hasChain (cases[0].nextCaseId && cases[1].prevCaseId); returns one_step_ok only when both conditions met; sandbox:false enables real file writes; directly tests the one-step scenario: all _ids missing → fixture_migrate adds both _id and chain links in one pass; testIntent requirement "fixture_migrate 一步到位补 _id 和链关系" is covered with a falsifiable assertion | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 手动乱序修改 fixture 数组顺序后再跑迁移 → 脚本按修改后的数组顺序建立链

results.note: fixture-migrate.json:73 — execute calls fixture_migrate({dryRun:true}) and expects pattern "done"; testIntent requires: manually reorder fixture array, run migration, verify chain follows the reordered array sequence; the test never creates a fixture with manually reordered cases, never calls migrate without dryRun, and never reads back the fixture to verify chain order matches the new array order; checking that dryRun returns done is completely unrelated to the reorder-then-migrate scenario | severity:high

fixture-migrate.json:77 — execute creates _test_reorder_migrate.json with B_first at array index 0 and A_second at array index 1 (manually reordered); calls fixture_migrate(); reads back and verifies cases[0].nextCaseId===cases[1]._id && cases[1].prevCaseId===cases[0]._id; returns reorder_chain_ok or wrong_order; sandbox:false enables real FS writes; testIntent "手动乱序修改 fixture 数组顺序后再跑迁移 → 脚本按修改后的数组顺序建立链" is directly verified — B→A chain follows the reordered array, not any presumed original order | severity:info
